idea-plugin.name: Notebook Share Gate
idea-plugin.description:
18 rules that read saved .ipynb outputs — 23 findings in the 6-cell sample notebook, 0 in the cleared one

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Notebook Share Gate: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 18 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/notebook-share-gate (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/notebook-share-gate

action.text: Notebook Share Gate: Check This File
action.description: Run Notebook Share Gate on the file in the editor
